OutBeat 2.8.9 ✨

You can finally test alerts properly — Test now reaches your
browser source, so you can check OBS works without going live.

Also: Test fires the alert you actually picked, Stop actually
stops, and alert backgrounds no longer go missing.

The editor's tidier too — settings in groups, Width/Height
sliders, and every colour swatch finally has a label.

Update from inside the app 💛

OutBeat 2.8.8 ✨

Live alerts fixed: Test now shows the alert you actually picked, Stop actually stops, and alert backgrounds no longer go missing.

The editor's tidier too — settings in groups, Width/Height sliders, and every colour swatch finally has a label.

Tip: if alerts aren't showing, check the ON AIR switch.

Update from inside the app.

OutBeat 2.8.8

The editor got a tidy-up. Same app, much less hunting.

*Settings now fold into groups — Text, Fill, Style, Place. One opens
 at a time, and a closed one tells you what it's set to
*Album art, the progress bar, the equalizer and the buttons get
 Width and Height sliders instead of one px box
*Every colour swatch says what it paints — Rewind, Play, Next, Key,
 Glyph, Record, Groove, and the rest
*Fixed: the Fill row was quietly taking the swatches that belonged to
 other settings, which is why Middle key was an empty box
*Designs that paint their own buttons no longer offer colours that do
 nothing — they say so instead
*Fill, Outline, Shadow and Gradient are buttons that light up now,
 not tiny switches
*The Theme menu is four short lines, and picking an app icon is a
 dropdown rather than a wall of tiles
*Text on the default theme reads properly again — the greys had been
 missing on that one skin

OutBeat 2.8.5

Live widgets are taking a short break.

We shipped them in 2.8.4 and we're not happy with them yet — some
of it works, some of it changes shape depending on where you're
streaming from, and we'd rather fix that than have you build a
setup twice. Open LIVE WIDGETS and you'll get a note and a way
back home until they're ready.

Nothing else changes. Your music overlay, presets, themes, browser
sources and everything you've already arranged work exactly as
before.

If you set up live widgets in 2.8.4, your browser sources keep
running — it's only the arranging that's closed for now.

Sorry for the back-and-forth. We'd rather do this than leave you
building on something that's about to move.

OutBeat 2.8.4

TikTok is here.
Open LIVE WIDGETS, choose TikTok, type your @handle — that's it.
No sign-in, no key, nothing to sign up for anywhere. While you're
live you'll get alerts for follows, joins, gifts (it names the gift)
and shares.

A chat widget.
Your chat on your overlay, as a layer you can drag and size like
anything else. Twitch needs no sign-in at all, just your channel
name. Pick the plain look or the panel, choose how many lines show
at once, and set the fonts and colours for names and messages
separately.

LIVE WIDGETS works differently now.
You start by choosing where you stream from — Twitch, TikTok or
YouTube. Connecting is once only, and the button tells you whether
you're connected. There's an ON AIR switch: flip it off and nothing
shows up on your stream.

Alerts are added one at a time.
"+ Follow alert", "+ Gift alert", and so on. Each one gets its own
stage with only that alert on it, and its own background. Chat and
the follower goal are yours to add if you want them, so they don't
use up alert slots. Five alerts on TikTok, ten on Twitch.

YouTube isn't ready yet — it's there so you can see it coming.

*Fixes the app icon not changing on your desktop shortcut. If your Desktop is backed up by OneDrive, the app was looking for the shortcut in the old location and never finding it. The tray and taskbar always worked

*Turned items can be moved again instead of sticking
*Resizing a turned item follows your cursor properly
*No more empty space around the cassette artwork

*Bug fixes,
*Feedback menu - so you can say whatever you want to us, we're used to it at this point XD
The Update button, and the sketch backgrounds.
